title: Revised evidence data and frozen-snapshot replay code for decision-centered machine learning validation in geological CO2 storage
description: Curated review data and deterministic frozen-snapshot replay code for 68 evaluated-document units and the selected 23-unit verified-journal sensitivity subset. This version includes the recovered S10c-S10i search addendum, current coding manual, S28a/S28b correspondence tables and annotation-only FA014 erratum. Scientific classifications, scores, memberships, seven indicators and the historical 627-item comparison are unchanged. Two isolated local replays matched 58 scientific reference CSVs. Data/documentation: CC BY 4.0; code: MIT. Manuscripts, private correspondence/approvals, copyrighted full texts and credentials are excluded. This is a data/code archive, not a preprint.
